request.prompt: You are helping a hotel engineering team. Describe what is visible in 2-3 sentences, focusing on any safety or maintenance issue. Then add one sentence starting 'Unsure:' saying what you cannot tell from the image.

response.text:
A large, gray air handling unit is elevated on a metal frame inside a mechanical room with overhead ductwork and piping. A significant stream of liquid is actively leaking from the bottom of the unit, creating a large standing puddle on the concrete floor below. This presents an immediate maintenance issue regarding a system failure and poses a severe slip hazard for personnel.

Unsure: whether the leaking fluid is clean condensate water, oil, or chemical coolant from within the unit.
